_comment: Template for .claude/settings.json. SETUP.md copies this and fills it.
allow/ask/deny come from the stack profile's 'Tool commands' section (PROFILE.builder.md)
plus what the target repo actually uses. Delete this _comment key when filling.
Rules of thumb for the lists: allow only what is read-only or trivially reversible; ask for
anything that writes outside the repo, publishes, or costs money; deny reads of secrets and
edits of generated files. A permission you are unsure about belongs in ask, not allow.
